The Creation.alt: Blue dawn over a rocky coast, rolling waves and green headlands.

The Fall of Man.alt: A clothed couple leaves a rain-darkened forest along a rocky path.

Cain and Abel.alt: Two brothers stand apart beside grain, sheep and an offering place.

The Line of Seth.alt: An older adult, younger adults and a child cross green farmland.

Noah and the Flood.alt: A family stands near a large wooden ark under clearing storm clouds.

Noahic Covenant.alt: Noah’s family watches a rainbow above rain-washed wetlands.

The Family of Noah.alt: Noah and his family gather grapes beneath a shaded vineyard canopy.

The Tower of Babel.alt: Builders pause beside an unfinished mudbrick tower in a dusty city.

The Call of Abram.alt: Abram’s household travels through rocky highlands before dawn.

Abrahamic Covenant.alt: Abram looks up at a star-filled sky beside a lamplit tent.

Abram and Lot.alt: Abram and Lot choose separate paths above a green valley.

Hagar and Ishmael.alt: Pregnant Hagar rests beside a spring in a shaded red canyon.

Abraham and Sarah’s Covenant.alt: Sarah listens from a shaded tent as Abraham serves three visitors.

Lot Leaves Sodom.alt: Lot and his daughters leave a burning city as a woman turns back.

Isaac and Ishmael.alt: Hagar draws water from a well while Ishmael rests in tree shade.

The Binding of Isaac.alt: Abraham and Isaac stand beside a stone altar and a ram caught in thorn scrub.

Isaac and Rebekah.alt: Rebekah pours water for a camel while Abraham’s servant watches beside a village well.

Jacob and Esau.alt: Jacob offers a bowl of stew to Esau beside a cooking fire.

Jacob’s Household.alt: Jacob’s household tends children and sheep beneath sunlit linen awnings.

Jacob Returns to Canaan.alt: Jacob and Esau embrace beside a river after rain.

Dinah at Shechem.alt: Dinah walks through a city gate with her two brothers behind her.

The Death of Rachel.alt: Jacob mourns beside Rachel’s grave as a woman holds a newborn.

Joseph and His Brothers.alt: Joseph wears a distinctive coat while his brothers gather apart behind a wall.

Judah and Tamar.alt: Tamar presents a seal, cord and staff to Judah and two witnesses.

Joseph in Egypt.alt: Joseph supervises wheat storage at Egyptian granaries.

Joseph Reunites His Family.alt: Joseph embraces a brother as his family gathers in an Egyptian hall.

Jacob Blesses His Family.alt: Elderly Jacob blesses two boys while Joseph watches beside his bed.

Israel Oppressed in Egypt.alt: Hebrew workers shape mud and straw into bricks in an Egyptian yard.

The Birth and Rescue of Moses.alt: Pharaoh’s daughter opens a basket holding baby Moses among Nile reeds.

Moses Flees to Midian.alt: Young Moses waters sheep while Zipporah and her sisters stand beside a well.

The Burning Bush.alt: Barefoot Moses faces a living bush surrounded by flame at twilight.

Moses Returns to Egypt.alt: Moses walks beside a donkey carrying Zipporah and their children toward Egypt.

Moses and Aaron Before Pharaoh.alt: Moses and Aaron stand before Pharaoh in a columned Egyptian hall.

The Plagues of Egypt.alt: Farmers shield their faces as locusts sweep over fields beside a canal.

The Passover and the Death of the Firstb.alt: A family shares a lamplit Passover meal with travel bundles ready nearby.

The Exodus from Egypt.alt: Families leave Egypt with animals and bundles, following a distant pillar of cloud.

Crossing the Sea.alt: Moses leads families through a path between towering waters under moonlight.

Bitter Water, Manna and Quail.alt: Families gather small pale manna flakes into baskets near their wilderness tents.

Water from the Rock and the Battle with.alt: Moses stands by flowing rock water as families fill jars and drink.

Jethro Advises Moses.alt: Jethro advises Moses beneath a woven awning while elders hear people nearby.

The Covenant and Ten Commandments at Sin.alt: People wait below Sinai as lightning and clouds cover the mountain summit.

Sinai / Mosaic Covenant.alt: Moses holds a scroll before an attentive assembly near the wilderness camp.

The Covenant Is Sealed at Sinai.alt: Moses and elders gather at a stone altar surrounded by upright stones.

The Golden Calf.alt: Moses holds stone tablets while people gather around a small golden calf.

Moses Sees God's Glory.alt: Moses shelters in a rock cleft with a veil as bright light passes outside.

Building the Tabernacle.alt: Craftspeople weave colored cloth and fit wooden frames for the tabernacle.

Aaron and His Sons Are Ordained.alt: Moses anoints Aaron while his sons stand beside the tabernacle.

Nadab and Abihu.alt: Two priests hold smoking incense pans near the tabernacle entrance.

The Blasphemer Stoned.alt: A man faces Moses and gathered elders outside the wilderness camp.
